name: portal-berita-tiket
description: Portal Berita Terpadu dan Sistem Pemesanan E-Tiket Bus Antar Kota

scripts.dev:all: APP_MODE=demo concurrently -n "berita,web,api" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix berita" "npm run dev --prefix Eticket/apps/web" "npm run dev --prefix Eticket/apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Eticket/apps/web && npm run build --prefix Eticket/apps/api
scripts.start:all: npm run build && APP_MODE=${APP_MODE:-production} concurrently -n "berita,web,api" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm start --prefix berita" "npm start --prefix Eticket/apps/web" "npm start --prefix Eticket/apps/api"
